report.explanation: Alert shows four checkout calls, all HTTP 200, with one 344 ms outlier and three at 62-78 ms. Traces show all spans ok with no errors; metrics show zero 502s and no dependency failures. No evidence establishes a bounded fault among the taxonomy causes; the single slow request is insufficient to attribute a root cause.
missing_evidence: Per-dependency latency breakdown for the 344 ms checkout request to localize the slow span
Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to judge whether 344 ms is anomalous
Error/timeout logs or dependency operation metrics showing failures
Resource saturation metrics (CPU, connection pool, memory) for gateway and downstream services
